title: Sonadoba N.E.L.C jwngni mondoli
lyrics:
​Ch.
Sonadoba N.E.L.C jwngni mondoli
Khusi-khusi jwngla khusi, dinwi jubilee -2
Jwngnibw lubi, khusiw bwswrari
Sibigwn khulumgwn, boibw jwng firi-firi -2
Ha ha ha la la la la
​(A)
Rongjanaini ojakkhw, gibinaini hangkhw
Somaina girja,nwi gjwngnw hwbai
Daosri haya jwng, han-bai hwyw jwng
Aoswi gihlai,ajon nwi labai-2
​(B)
Mondolikhouw jwngni, ajaonanwi labai
Nwi rwja mathaini, dinwini sanao
Gotthibari jwngni, Gossaibari circle
Jwngkhou onnanwi,gojobna labai -2
